jobId.description: Greenhouse job post id (the number in the job URL and gh_jid).

internalJobId.description: Greenhouse internal job id (the job, not the post; one job can have several posts).

requisitionId.description: Requisition id set by the employer, if any.

boardToken.description: Greenhouse board token (lower case); with jobId it identifies the job.

companyName.description: Company name as published on the board.

location.description: Location text shown on the posting.

offices.description: Names of the offices the job is attached to.

officePath.description: Hierarchy path of the first office, root to leaf, e.g. North America > USA > San Francisco.

departments.description: Names of the departments the job belongs to.

departmentPath.description: Hierarchy path of the first department, root to leaf.

remote.description: Heuristic: location or office says remote / work from home / WFH / anywhere, the title has a stand-alone 'remote', or a workplace-type custom field says Remote.

absoluteUrl.description: Public job URL as returned by Greenhouse (often the company's own careers page with gh_jid).

applyUrl.description: Greenhouse-hosted job URL job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>/jobs/<id>; it redirects to the company page when the board is embedded there.

updatedAt.description: Last update of the posting (ISO 8601 with offset).

firstPublishedAt.description: When the posting was first published (ISO 8601), if the board reports it.

content.description: Job description in the format chosen by includeContent (text, html or markdown). Absent when includeContent is none.

payRanges.description: Only with includePayRanges. List of {min, max, currency, title, description} in currency units (not cents); empty list = none published, null = the detail request failed.

customFields.description: The board's custom fields as {name: value}; values keep their type (string, list, boolean, null). Absent when includeCustomFields is off.

questions.description: Only with includeQuestions. Main application form fields: {label, required, type, name, description, options[{label,value}]}; null = the detail request failed.

locationQuestions.description: Only with includeQuestions. The form's location question(s), same shape as questions, without the hidden latitude/longitude fields; null = the detail request failed.

complianceQuestions.description: Only with includeQuestions. Compliance question groups (for example EEOC): {type, description, questions[...]} with questions shaped like questions; empty list = none; null = the detail request failed.

demographicQuestions.description: Only with includeQuestions. The demographic survey: {header, description, questions[{id,label,required,type,options[{label,value,freeForm}]}]}; null = none published or the detail request failed.

scrapedAt.description: When the record was produced (ISO 8601, UTC).
